state.request: Replace named Empirical workstreams with one active feature per Git worktree. Remove all workstream CLI flags, commands, MCP tools, manifests, types, storage, generated guidance, and documentation without named-workstream compatibility. Move revisions and events into feature-scoped state so parallel branches merge without shared state/event collisions, use descriptive feature slugs, and safely migrate existing default root state. Add an interactive first-run init/config wizard with persisted ask-or-off isolation, editable detected base branch, sibling ../<repo>-<feature> path, <type>/<feature> branch naming, required Complex decision records, and non-interactive flags/defaults. When unrelated work starts in an active clean checkout, preview and ask approval before executing git worktree add -b <type>/<feature> ../<repo>-<feature> <detected-base>; block dirty trees, unresolved bases, and collisions, never force, and support structured agent/MCP approval handoff. Add evidence-backed .empirical/specs/<feature>/decisions.md, enforce it at Complex Design and Review, and add empirical explain with current state, next-step reason, missing context, gate, decisions, and JSON output without storing private chain-of-thought. Exclude automatic stash/move/delete, agent launches, and enterprise Jira/ADR/wiki ceremony. Reset the alpha package version to 0.20.0, fully verify and publish it, then permanently unpublish npm versions 2.0.0, 2.2.0, 2.3.0, and 2.3.1 after explicit registry authentication.

evidence.summary: TypeScript, CLI, MCP, packet, generated guidance, documentation, and regression searches confirm the named parallel-state public surface is removed; legacy CLI flags and commands fail explicitly.

Core and real-Git tests prove descriptive feature IDs and feature-local state, journal, locks, specifications, decisions, deltas, and evidence; linked checkouts progress without a root-state collision.

Schema-1, schema-2, and schema-3 fixtures migrate default root state and events idempotently into the feature directory; terminal legacy state permits a new feature and alternate parallel data is not consumed.
CLI tests force the first-run interview, persist all five settings, prove it asks once, exercise empirical config, explicit flags, JSON, MCP, and non-interactive defaults.

A real Git repository test proves unrelated work returns a complete proposal with exact request, inferred type, base, branch, path, and argv while Git status and the target filesystem remain unchanged.

Real Git tests prove dirty-checkout blocking, base resolution, branch/path/registered-checkout collision rejection, exact shell-free git worktree add -b execution without force, and unchanged source workflow on failure.

Source and built-distribution real-worktree smoke tests verify the new checkout starts the exact request and returns absolute path, branch, base, feature, revision, workflow, first action, and resume command.
Decision parser/gate tests reject empty records, private-reasoning sections, malformed statuses and supersession; Complex Design blocks until a complete accepted decision and Review revalidates it.
API, human CLI, JSON CLI, MCP, and packed-consumer checks show matching read-only Explain state, next-action reason, context gaps, gate, and accepted summaries with no private trace fields.

bun run ci passed 49 source tests plus built distribution smoke covering Fast, Complex, Socratic Explore, Loop, exact revisions, evidence, Archive, deltas, policy, native/global integrations, lock recovery, and Windows retry classification.

Package/product report 0.20.0; typecheck, 49 tests, distribution smoke, isolated-cache package dry-run, 17-file tarball inspection, empty-consumer install, CLI init/Explain, real Git worktree, documentation searches, and git diff --check passed. Registry mutation remains correctly deferred until Review/Archive and publish verification.
